title: Customers can see they can pay with mada, Apple Pay, Tabby or Tamara before checkout
pass: On the phone product page (near Add to cart) and in the cart, the payment methods the store accepts are shown as logos or text: mada, Apple Pay, Tabby, Tamara, STC Pay, cash on delivery, as offered.
fails: No payment logos on the product page or cart, or only Visa/Mastercard shown, so a shopper who wants mada or instalments only finds out at checkout or leaves.
validate: Headless phone and desktop visit of the product page and the cart: search the DOM (img alt/src, svg titles, class names, visible text) for mada, Apple Pay, Visa, Mastercard, STC Pay, Tabby, Tamara and cash-on-delivery wording; record which appear and whether they sit in the first screen near Add to cart and near the cart's checkout button. Screenshot both. Payment setup itself is not visible to us: mark 'confirm with owner' for methods offered but not shown.
action: Show the payment logos you accept (mada, Apple Pay, Tabby, Tamara, cash on delivery) under the Add to cart button and next to the checkout button in the cart. Most themes have a payment-icons setting or block for this.
done_when: On a phone, the product page and the cart both show the payment methods you accept without scrolling past the buy button.
why_it_matters: Shoppers who don't see their way to pay stop before checkout, so the sale is lost after they already chose the product.
selected_because: Top store-owner leak in the spec (payment visibility), Elevr list item, tested in CRO audits, owner can fix in the admin.

title: Delivery cost is shown before checkout
pass: The product page or the cart states the delivery cost (or how it is worked out, by city or order value), so the shopper knows the full price before checkout.
fails: The cart says delivery is calculated at checkout or says nothing, and no delivery-cost text is reachable from the product page; the cost first appears at the last step.
validate: Headless phone visit of product page and cart after our add to cart: search visible text for delivery/shipping cost wording (توصيل, شحن, delivery, shipping) with an amount or a rule; note 'calculated at checkout' wording. Public crawl of the delivery/shipping policy page linked from the footer to see if costs are listed. Screenshot cart.
action: Write the delivery cost in the cart and on the product page (for example the price per city or 'free above X'), and keep the delivery policy page linked from both.
done_when: A phone shopper can read the delivery cost on the product page or in the cart before tapping checkout.
why_it_matters: A delivery cost that appears only at the last step is a common reason buyers drop out after adding to cart.
selected_because: Spec ranks late shipping cost high for this reader; tested and failed in 3 of 5 audited stores; owner setting.

title: Free-delivery threshold is shown and explained
pass: If the store offers free delivery above an amount, that amount is stated on the home page bar or product page, and the cart tells the shopper how much more they need to add.
fails: Free delivery is offered but the amount is not shown, the bar says 'free delivery' with no amount, or the cart gives no 'add X more' message.
validate: Headless phone visit of home, product and cart: search visible text for free-delivery wording (توصيل مجاني, شحن مجاني, free delivery/shipping) and capture any amount next to it; in the cart (with our one product) check for a remaining-amount message or progress bar. Crawl the delivery policy page for the threshold. If no free-delivery offer is found anywhere, mark 'not offered or not shown, confirm with owner'.
action: State the free-delivery amount in the top bar and on the product page, and turn on a cart message that shows how much more the customer needs to add.
done_when: Home or product page shows the free-delivery amount and the cart shows the remaining amount for the current order.
why_it_matters: A clear free-delivery amount gives shoppers a reason to add one more item, which raises order value.
selected_because: Elevr list item and a high-scoring delivery lever in the spec; visible storefront fact.

title: Cash-on-delivery fee is stated before checkout
pass: If cash on delivery is offered, the product page, cart or delivery policy page says whether it has a fee and how much.
fails: Cash on delivery is mentioned but the fee is not, so the shopper meets an extra charge at the last step; or COD wording only appears inside checkout.
validate: Headless phone visit of product page and cart plus public crawl of the delivery/payment policy pages: search for COD wording (الدفع عند الاستلام, cash on delivery, COD) and, where found, for a fee amount or 'no fee' wording near it. If COD wording is not found, mark 'COD offer not visible, confirm with owner'. We do not open checkout.
action: Add one line near the payment logos and in the delivery policy: 'Cash on delivery: fee X' or 'Cash on delivery with no extra fee'.
done_when: The COD fee (or 'no fee') is readable on the product page, the cart or the linked delivery page.
why_it_matters: An unexpected COD fee at the last step makes buyers abandon or refuse the order at the door.
selected_because: Elevr list item; spec scores hidden COD fee high; checkable from storefront text and policy pages.

title: WhatsApp button is easy to see on phones and doesn't cover the buy button
pass: On the phone product page and cart, a WhatsApp (or other contact) button is visible and does not cover Add to cart or the checkout button.
fails: No WhatsApp link at all, the link is only in the footer, the button is hidden on mobile, or it sits on top of the buy button.
validate: Headless phone visit of product page and cart: find links to wa.me, api.whatsapp.com or whatsapp:// and chat widgets; check the element's box is inside the viewport and visible, and that it does not overlap the Add to cart or checkout button boxes. Whether the number itself works is checked in the website section. Also note other contact routes (phone, email) in header/footer. Screenshot.
action: Turn on the floating WhatsApp button for mobile and place it so it does not cover the Add to cart or checkout buttons.
done_when: On a phone, a WhatsApp button shows on the product page and cart and leaves the buy buttons clear.
why_it_matters: GCC shoppers ask questions on WhatsApp before buying; a hidden button turns those questions into lost orders.
selected_because: Elevr list item and spec high-score item on mobile-heavy stores; tested (2 of 5 failed); owner setting.

title: Add to cart is in the first phone screen
pass: On a 375px phone, the product page shows the price and the Add to cart button without scrolling, or a sticky Add to cart appears as soon as the shopper scrolls.
fails: Add to cart sits below a tall gallery, banners or long text, so the shopper has to scroll to find how to buy.
validate: Headless phone visit (375px) of the product page: locate the Add to cart button and the price, read their bounding boxes and check they fall inside the first viewport; scroll once and check for a sticky buy bar. Screenshot the first screen.
action: Move the price and Add to cart up under the first product photo, or turn on the theme's sticky Add to cart bar for mobile.
done_when: A 375px screenshot of the product page shows the price and Add to cart (or a sticky bar) without scrolling.
why_it_matters: When the buy button is out of sight on a phone, fewer product visitors add to cart.
selected_because: Direct lever on product page to add to cart; tested (2 of 5 failed); measured exactly by the phone visit.

title: Product titles are in Arabic
pass: On the Arabic store, product titles on the collection page and the product page are written in Arabic (brand or model names in Latin letters are fine).
fails: Arabic pages show English-only product titles, or titles copied from the supplier with codes and no Arabic name.
validate: Headless visit of the Arabic version of the collection and product pages: read the product card titles and the product h1; compute the share of titles that contain Arabic letters; list the English-only titles found.
action: Add an Arabic title to each product in the product editor, starting with your best-selling products; keep the brand name as is.
done_when: All product titles on the Arabic collection page and the opened product page contain an Arabic name.
why_it_matters: Arabic-speaking shoppers find and trust products faster when the name is in their language.
selected_because: Elevr list item; spec scores Arabic product titles high; owner fixes in the product editor.

title: Arabic pages read right to left on the phone, cart included
pass: Arabic pages declare lang=ar and dir=rtl, and the product page and cart lay out right to left on a phone: prices, quantity, remove and checkout buttons in the right places with no overlapping or cut text.
fails: Arabic text inside a left-to-right layout, mirrored icons, prices or numbers jumbled, or cart rows that overlap or cut off on a phone.
validate: Headless phone visit of the Arabic home, product and cart pages: read html lang/dir and the computed direction of the main product and cart containers; check for elements whose boxes overflow the viewport or overlap in the cart; screenshot the cart for review.
action: Ask your developer or theme support to fix the right-to-left layout on the product page and cart for Arabic.
done_when: Arabic product page and cart screenshots on a phone show a correct right-to-left layout with nothing overlapping.
why_it_matters: A broken Arabic cart makes the store look unsafe at the moment the customer decides to pay.
selected_because: Spec scores RTL breaks in the cart high on mobile-heavy stores; the current tool already reads lang/dir.

title: Cart shows the same price and a clear total
pass: After adding our product, the cart shows the same price as the product page, a clear subtotal or total, and says whether delivery and VAT are included.
fails: The cart price differs from the product page, the discount shown on the product page is missing in the cart, or the total is unclear about delivery and VAT.
validate: Headless phone visit: record the price (and any sale price) on the product page, add the product to the cart, then read the cart line price, subtotal and total and any 'VAT included' or delivery wording. Flag any mismatch between product page and cart prices. Screenshot.
action: Check the product's price and discount settings so the cart shows the same price, and add a line under the total saying whether VAT and delivery are included.
done_when: Product page price equals the cart line price, and the cart total states what it includes.
why_it_matters: A price that changes between the product page and the cart breaks trust right before checkout.
selected_because: Hidden or changing total is a known cart leak; we add one product so the comparison is exact. Covers the measurable part of the Elevr 'coupon vs cart price' item.

title: Checkout button in the cart is clear on the phone
pass: The cart has one clear checkout button visible on a phone without scrolling (or sticky), with a plain label such as 'إتمام الطلب'.
fails: The checkout button is below the fold, looks like a secondary link, competes with several other buttons, or the label is unclear.
validate: Headless phone visit of the cart after our add to cart: locate the checkout button, read its label and bounding box, check it is in the first viewport or sticky, and count other buttons of equal weight. Screenshot.
action: Make the checkout button the main button in the cart and keep it visible on mobile (sticky if the cart is long).
done_when: A phone screenshot of the cart shows the checkout button without scrolling.
why_it_matters: People who already added to cart need an obvious next step, or they leave the cart without buying.
selected_because: Direct cart-to-checkout lever, the step store owners lose most; measured exactly in the cart visit.

title: Pay-in-instalments price is shown on the product page
pass: If the store offers Tabby or Tamara, the product page shows the instalment line under the price (for example 'or 4 payments of X'), and the cart shows it too.
fails: Tabby or Tamara is offered at checkout but no instalment line shows on the product page or cart, or the widget loads empty.
validate: Headless phone visit of product page and cart: look for Tabby or Tamara widget elements or scripts in the DOM and network, and for instalment text near the price; check the widget renders text, not an empty box. If no BNPL is found, mark 'not visible, confirm with owner whether Tabby or Tamara is active'.
action: Turn on the Tabby or Tamara product-page widget from the app or payment settings so the instalment amount shows under the price.
done_when: The product page and cart show the instalment line with an amount on a phone.
why_it_matters: Seeing a smaller instalment amount helps shoppers commit to higher-priced items.
selected_because: Elevr list (Tabby/Tamara on product and cart); distinct from logos because it shows the instalment amount; visible in DOM and network.

title: Phone layout has no sideways scroll and buttons are easy to tap
pass: Home, collection, product and cart pages fit the phone width with no sideways scroll; Add to cart, quantity, menu and checkout targets are 44px or more.
fails: Pages scroll sideways, or the buy, quantity or remove buttons are too small to tap.
validate: Headless 375px visit of the four pages: compare document scrollWidth with viewport width; measure the bounding boxes of Add to cart, quantity controls, menu and checkout buttons against 44px; list failures with screenshots.
action: Ask your developer to remove the element causing sideways scroll and enlarge the small buy and quantity buttons on mobile.
done_when: No sideways scroll on the four pages and all listed buttons measure 44px or more.
why_it_matters: Most store visits are on phones; missed taps and a wobbling page lose buyers on the way to the cart.
selected_because: Mobile usability on the buying path; current tool already measures it; merged with tap-size and mobile readability candidates.

title: Delivery time is shown before buying
pass: The product page (or collection cards) states how long delivery takes, in days or by city.
fails: No delivery time anywhere before checkout, or only inside a policy page that is not linked from the product page.
validate: Headless phone visit of collection and product pages: search visible text for delivery-time wording (توصيل خلال, أيام, delivery in, days) with a number; crawl the linked delivery policy page for times. Screenshot.
action: Add a short line under the price: 'Delivery in X to Y days' (by city if it differs).
done_when: The product page shows a delivery time on a phone.
why_it_matters: Shoppers who don't know when the order arrives hesitate, especially for gifts and occasions.
selected_because: Delivery expectation is a GCC trust moment; tested (3 of 5 failed); owner can add text.

title: Return and exchange policy is easy to find
pass: A return/exchange policy is linked from the footer on all pages and mentioned near Add to cart, the page loads, and it is in Arabic; privacy and terms pages are linked too.
fails: No return policy link, a broken policy page, an English-only policy on the Arabic store, or return terms only revealed after purchase.
validate: Headless visit and public crawl: find footer links to return/exchange, privacy and terms pages on home, product and cart; fetch each and check status 200 and Arabic text; search the product page for return wording near Add to cart.
action: Publish a short Arabic return and exchange policy, link it in the footer, and add one line near Add to cart (for example 'Exchange within X days').
done_when: Footer links to return, privacy and terms pages work, and the product page mentions returns near the buy button.
why_it_matters: Clear return terms reduce the fear of buying from a store the shopper doesn't know yet.
selected_because: Spec lists returns as a medium product-page trust lever; merged policy-link candidates into one point.

title: Reviews and ratings show on product and collection pages
pass: The product page shows real customer reviews with a rating and count near the title, the rating links to the reviews, and collection cards show stars where reviews exist.
fails: No reviews block, a widget showing zero reviews, a rating that doesn't link to the reviews, or reviews only in English on the Arabic store.
validate: Headless visit of product and collection pages: detect review widgets and rating elements (stars, counts) in the DOM; read the review count; check the rating links or scrolls to the review section; check review text language. Screenshot.
action: Turn on product reviews, show the rating under the product title, and ask recent buyers for a review (WhatsApp works well).
done_when: The product page shows a rating with a count under the title, and collection cards show stars.
why_it_matters: Reviews from other buyers are what convinces a hesitant first-time shopper to add to cart.
selected_because: Product-page trust (medium in spec); tested in CRO audits; merged four review candidates.

title: Product page has several clear photos
pass: The product page gallery has more than one photo (different angles, in use or with size reference), and the photos load sharp on a phone.
fails: A single photo, the same photo repeated, or blurry images.
validate: Headless phone visit of the product page: count unique gallery image URLs, read their natural sizes against displayed sizes. Screenshot the gallery.
action: Upload extra photos for each product: different angles, the product in use and a size reference.
done_when: The opened product shows more than one distinct sharp photo on a phone.
why_it_matters: Shoppers can't touch the product; more photos answer their doubts and lead to more add to carts.
selected_because: Highest-scoring tested pool candidate; owner fixes in the product editor; directly measurable.

title: Product description answers buyer questions, in Arabic
pass: The product page has an Arabic description that covers what the shopper needs to decide: size or dimensions, material or ingredients, how to use, what is in the box.
fails: Empty or one-line description, supplier text in English on the Arabic store, or key facts (size, material) missing.
validate: Headless visit of the Arabic product page: extract the description text, measure its length, check the share of Arabic letters, and look for size/material/usage terms; the model reviews the text against the product type.
action: Rewrite the description of your top products in Arabic with size, material, how to use and what's included.
done_when: The opened product's description is in Arabic and states size, material and use.
why_it_matters: Missing details make shoppers leave to ask or to buy elsewhere.
selected_because: Spec lists missing Arabic description as medium; tested (3 of 5 failed); merged two description candidates.

title: Sale price and saving are clear
pass: Prices show on every collection card, and discounted products show the old and new price (and the saving) on the card and the product page.
fails: Price missing on cards, old price shown without the new one, or a discount shown on the card but not on the product page.
validate: Headless visit of collection and product pages: check each card has a price; where a compare-at or crossed-out price exists, check the new price and saving appear on the product page too. Price carry-over into the cart is checked in the cart-price point.
action: Set the old price (compare-at price) on discounted products so the saving shows everywhere, and keep the price visible on all product cards.
done_when: Every collection card shows a price, and a discounted product shows old and new price on the card and the product page.
why_it_matters: A clear saving gets deal-seeking shoppers to act; an unclear price makes them doubt the offer.
selected_because: Price clarity is a medium spec item; tested; owner admin setting.

title: Sold-out products don't block the shopper
pass: No sold-out product sits in the home banner or the first row of home or a collection; sold-out products and sizes are clearly marked and sit after in-stock items; a sold-out product page offers similar items or a 'notify me'.
fails: Sold-out products featured in the home banner or first row, many sold-out products at the top of the collection, sold-out sizes selectable until the cart, or a sold-out page with no way forward.
validate: Headless visit of home and the collection page: read the products in the hero and first row and their stock state from the page and product schema, count cards marked sold out and their positions; on the product page read variant availability (disabled options, out-of-stock text) and check for similar-product or notify-me blocks.
action: Swap sold-out products out of your home banner and first rows, move them to the end of collections, and add 'similar products' or 'notify me' on sold-out pages.
done_when: No sold-out product in the home banner or first row of home and collections, and sold-out pages show alternatives.
why_it_matters: Shoppers who land on sold-out items, often from ads, leave instead of buying something else.
selected_because: Stock problems lose ready buyers; owner manages stock; visible on collection and product pages. Merged with removed SO-WC-12 (sold-out products in the first spots).

title: Language switch and prices in the right currency
pass: A language switch (Arabic/English) is easy to find on the phone, and prices show in the store currency (for example SAR) the same way on product, cart and collection; if a currency switch exists it works.
fails: No language switch, the switch hidden deep in the menu, prices in a different currency than the store sells in, or mixed currencies between pages.
validate: Headless phone visit of home, collection, product and cart: find language and currency switch controls in header or menu and their visibility; read the currency symbol or code on prices on each page and check they match; follow the language switch link and check the Arabic/English page loads.
action: Show the language switch in the mobile header and set prices to show in your store currency on every page.
done_when: Language switch visible on the phone header, and the same currency on collection, product and cart.
why_it_matters: Shoppers who can't read the page in their language or see a strange currency don't buy.
selected_because: Elevr list item (currency and language switching); tested (3 of 5 failed); platform setting.

title: Related products shown to raise order value
pass: The product page or cart shows related or complementary products that can be added in one tap.
fails: No related products on the product page or cart, or a block that shows the same product or sold-out items.
validate: Headless visit of product page and cart: detect related/recommended product blocks (section headings such as منتجات مشابهة, recommendation app scripts) and count in-stock items in them.
action: Turn on the related-products section on product pages and a 'you may also like' block in the cart.
done_when: Product page and cart each show at least one in-stock related product.
why_it_matters: Suggesting a matching item lets buyers add more to the same order.
selected_because: Order-value lever; tested (4 of 5 lacked tools); owner app or theme setting.

title: Cart icon is always visible in the phone header
pass: On a phone, a cart icon shows in the header of home, collection and product pages and opens the cart.
fails: The cart icon is missing on mobile, hidden in the menu, or scrolls away, so shoppers can't get back to their cart.
validate: Headless phone visit of home, collection and product: find the header cart link or icon, check it is visible in the first viewport and links to the cart.
action: Turn on the cart icon in the mobile header in your theme settings.
done_when: The cart icon shows in the phone header on home, collection and product pages.
why_it_matters: Shoppers who can't find their cart again leave with items still in it.
selected_because: Backfill: highest-value unused CRO candidate, tested (2 of 5 failed); theme setting.

title: Search is easy to find on the phone
pass: A search icon or field is visible in the phone header on home and collection pages.
fails: No search on mobile, or search hidden inside the menu.
validate: Headless phone visit of home and collection: locate search inputs or search icons in the header and check they are visible in the first viewport.
action: Turn on the search icon in the mobile header in your theme settings.
done_when: Search shows in the phone header on home and collection pages.
why_it_matters: Shoppers who know what they want buy faster when they can search for it.
selected_because: Product-finding lever, tested (2 of 5 failed); simple theme fix.

title: Filter and sort are available on phone collection pages
pass: The collection page on a phone has visible filter and sort controls (including price), reachable without scrolling the whole list.
fails: Filters exist on desktop only, or there is no way to sort or filter on mobile.
validate: Headless phone visit of the collection page: find filter and sort controls and check they are visible in the first viewport or a sticky bar; note whether a price filter exists. Compare with desktop.
action: Turn on mobile filters and sort for collections in the theme, including a price filter.
done_when: A phone screenshot of the collection shows filter and sort controls.
why_it_matters: On large collections, shoppers who can't narrow down give up before finding a product.
selected_because: Mobile product finding on collection pages; tested; theme setting.

title: No heavy autoplay video on the phone first screen
pass: The phone home page first screen shows products or an image, not an autoplay video.
fails: An autoplay video fills the phone first screen, delaying the page and pushing products down.
validate: Headless phone visit of the home page: detect video elements with autoplay in the first viewport and record their file size from network requests. Screenshot.
action: Replace the mobile hero video with an image, or set the video to play only on tap.
done_when: The phone home page first screen has no autoplay video.
why_it_matters: A heavy video slows the first screen on mobile data, and slower pages lose visitors before they see a product.
selected_because: Current-tool point with a real mobile sales effect; owner can change the banner.
